definitions.gloss: as; in proportion to; along with (a change)
definitions.explanation: Marks a parallel change: as the first situation progresses, a second situation changes accordingly. Both clauses describe gradual, related shifts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とるにつれて、⟦{記憶力|きおくりょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: As one gets older, memory declines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ→時間が経つ：24138_jikangatatsu⟧につれて、⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{和|やわ}らいだ→和らぐ：07896_yawaragu⟧。
examples.english: As time passed, the pain eased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発展|はってん}する→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧につれて、⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧になった。
examples.english: As the economy developed, people's lives also became more affluent.

notes:
From the verb ⟦{連|つ}れる→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧ (to bring along) in て form, with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Treated as a fixed grammatical pattern.

ATTACHMENT:
- Plain present verb: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とるにつれて
- Noun: ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧につれて (along with growth)

The more formal written variant is ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つれ (drop て).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: as; in accordance with — more formal; can also mean 'according to (rules)'
- ⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧: along with — emphasizes simultaneity rather than proportional change
- ほど: the more... the more — used with comparison; emphasizes degree

NOTE: Both clauses must describe a change. Cannot be used with one-time events: ✗ ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧につれて、⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
